QUESTION IT ANSWERS, which needs TIME and cannot be settled by any proof: is 1000 lines the right window? A retention window is only ever discovered to be wrong IN HINDSIGHT — someone reaches back for a boot the file no longer holds, at exactly the moment they cannot afford to discover it — so the discard has to leave a mark or the miss is invisible. THE MEASURE SHARPENED when the probe was built: not 'how many hours does the window span' (which needs a clock) but 'can it still show TWO RUNS' — a record that has turned over and now speaks for a single live process has stopped being a record and become a peephole onto the present, which is the one thing the process could already see.
